items.headline: Russell Westbrook Announces Retirement from NBA
items.summary: Nine-time All-Star and former MVP Russell Westbrook officially announced his retirement from professional basketball on August 12, 2026, concluding an illustrious 18-season career that included winning the NBA Most Valuable Player award in 2017.

items.headline: JJ Redick Receives Extension as Lakers Head Coach
items.summary: JJ Redick has received a contract extension with the Los Angeles Lakers, aligning his deal with General Manager Rob Pelinka's. Redick, 42, successfully led the Lakers to two consecutive 50-win seasons in his first two years as head coach.

items.headline: Giannis Antetokounmpo Traded to Miami Heat
items.summary: In a blockbuster deal from late July, two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo was traded to the Miami Heat. The Milwaukee Bucks received Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakučionis, the No. 13 pick in the 2026 draft, first-round picks in 2031 and 2033, and a 2030 pick swap.

items.headline: D'Angelo Russell Joins Memphis Grizzlies in Mega Trade
items.summary: Veteran guard D'Angelo Russell is headed to the Memphis Grizzlies as part of a historic six-team mega trade, providing Memphis with an experienced playmaker and valuable draft assets.

items.headline: Khris Middleton to Washington Wizards via Sign-and-Trade
items.summary: The Washington Wizards have strengthened their veteran core by acquiring Khris Middleton through a sign-and-trade deal, adding championship experience and leadership to their roster.

items.headline: Dillon Brooks Signs Three-Year, $73 Million Extension with Suns
items.summary: Canadian star Dillon Brooks has agreed to a three-year, $73 million extension with the Phoenix Suns. Brooks averaged a career-best 20.2 points in 56 games with Phoenix in the 2025-26 season.

items.headline: Lonnie Walker IV Returns to NBA, Signs with Nuggets
items.summary: After a season in the EuroLeague, Lonnie Walker IV is returning to the NBA, signing a one-year, $3.3 million deal with the Denver Nuggets on August 5.

items.headline: Gary Payton II Re-Joins Warriors on Veteran Deal
items.summary: Gary Payton II is heading back to the Golden State Warriors, signing a one-year, $3.9 million veteran deal as the team looks to fill out its roster.

items.headline: Jalen Duren, Pistons Remain Apart on Contract Extension
items.summary: Restricted free agent Jalen Duren, an All-NBA and All-Star player last season, remains at a stalemate with the Detroit Pistons over a contract extension. The Pistons are reportedly not considering sign-and-trade options.

items.headline: Golden State Warriors Crowned 2026 Las Vegas Summer League Champions
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors defeated the Memphis Grizzlies 94-90 to win the 2026 Las Vegas NBA Summer League championship, which concluded on July 19. Yaxel Lendeborg led the Warriors with 21 points and 10 rebounds in the title game and was named Finals & League MVP.

items.headline: Offseason Coaching Carousel Continues with New Hires
items.summary: Several teams have finalized their coaching staffs for the upcoming season. Recent head coaching hires include Tiago Splitter for the Chicago Bulls, Dusty May for the Dallas Mavericks, Taylor Jenkins for the Milwaukee Bucks, Jamahl Mosley for the New Orleans Pelicans, Sean Sweeney for the Orlando Magic, and Micah Nori for the Portland Trail Blazers.

items.headline: Kyle Lowry Retires After 20 Seasons
items.summary: NBA Champion Kyle Lowry announced his retirement from professional basketball on July 7, 2026, concluding a 20-season career and marking him as the last active player from the 2006 NBA draft.
